name: How can I prevent bad drain smells in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent bad drain smells in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent bad drain smells, regularly flush drains with hot water, especially after using your sink or shower. For kitchen drains, avoid pouring grease down the drain and use a strainer to catch food particles. Periodically pour a mixture of baking soda and vinegar down drains to break down buildup. Ensure all drains, especially those in guest bathrooms or utility rooms, are used occasionally to keep P-traps full of water. Regular maintenance can significantly reduce the likelihood of odors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent drain smells by regularly flushing with hot water, avoiding grease, using strainers, and occasionally pouring baking soda and vinegar down drains.
